top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at GFNY Uppsala. Practice on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 83 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Uppsala's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At mile 60 of 83, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
GFNY Uppsala's rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Uppsala. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Uppsala. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
At GFNY Uppsala, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Uppsala's rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling actually does to you.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 83 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Smooth pedaling at 83 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.weather: August in Uppsala, Sweden (start/finish at Ulva Kvarn). Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Uppsala. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Uppsala’s 83 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Uppsala rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and Durability to prepare you for 83 miles of rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling in Uppsala, Sweden (start/finish at Ulva Kvarn).
